plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Perform comprehensive code review for security, performance, and architecture. Save reviews to file, fix issues via /fix-report (paginated) or /fix-all (bulk, then offers to resolve needs-decision findings, optional severity floor). Persist PR review feedback via /analyze-feedback. Optional verification phase for cross-analysis and adversarial review. Composite findings group symptoms with one cause and are fixed as one unit.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Plan, route each task to the matching developer agent, review every task, then run the full code review. Oh My Pi only.
